# Requirements Quality Checklist: Arabic Text-to-Speech Prototype

**Purpose**: Validate that the Arabic, dialect, pronunciation, streaming, latency, provider-comparison, security, and production-architecture requirements are complete, unambiguous, measurable, and internally consistent — before implementation begins.
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Arabic Requirements Testability

- [ ] CHK001 Are the Arabic character classes that MUST NOT be folded enumerated explicitly rather than described generally? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "does not change meaning" for normalization expressed as a checkable rule rather than an intention? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are diacritic-preservation requirements distinguished from diacritic-*addition* requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the expected Arabic output for each difficult-content category specified per sample, so a test can assert on it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the pipeline stages required to be independently testable, and is their required order stated anywhere a reader could verify it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the distinction between digits that quantify and digits that identify defined by a rule, not by example alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for text containing no Arabic characters at all? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "intelligible Arabic speech" bounded by the specific failure modes it excludes, given that naturalness cannot be objectively tested? [Measurability, Spec §US1]

## Dialect Requirements Explicitness

- [ ] CHK009 Is the prohibition on claiming unpublished dialect support stated as a requirement rather than as guidance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the dialect families enumerated, and is each mapped to concrete locales? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-025a]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified what a locale with no claimed dialect family represents, so absence is distinguishable from omission? [Gap, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for a dialect family a selected provider cannot serve? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the boundary between locale-to-voice routing and dialectal text rewriting stated as an explicit exclusion? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the requirement to report which voice actually served a request consistent with the requirement to auto-select one? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025]

## Pronunciation Requirements Measurability

- [ ] CHK015 Is the requirement that the demonstrated defect be *observed* rather than hypothetical stated unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the fields required to document an observed defect enumerated, including the provider and voice that exhibited it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the ability to produce corrected and uncorrected audio from identical source text specified as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK018 Are pronunciation rules required to be data rather than logic, in terms a reviewer can check? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK019 Is rule scoping (locale, provider) specified, given that portable and provider-specific corrections must coexist? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the future rule categories (names, brands, places, medical, banking, foreign) enumerated so extensibility is verifiable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK021 Is behaviour specified for an ambiguous undiacritized word with no governing rule? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is there a requirement preventing a rule from matching inside a longer word, given Arabic prefix attachment? [Gap, Data Model §PronunciationRule]

## Streaming Requirements Clarity

- [ ] CHK023 Is "streams" defined as forwarding the first chunk on arrival, rather than merely returning a chunked response? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK024 Is streaming scoped to providers that support it, with a defined behaviour for those that do not? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the streaming success criterion stated in user-observable terms and given a pass threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for a client disconnecting mid-stream? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a provider failing *after* audio has already been sent? [Coverage, Contracts §http-api]
- [ ] CHK028 Is it specified how per-request metadata reaches the client when the response body is raw audio? [Gap, Contracts §http-api]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the audio format requirement tied to the property that makes progressive playback possible? [Traceability, Spec §FR-004, Research §R5]

## Latency Requirement Boundaries

- [ ] CHK030 Are all measured stage boundaries defined individually rather than as a single end-to-end figure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK031 Is each timing metric defined as a difference between two named marks, so it cannot be computed two ways? [Clarity, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK032 Are client-measured marks distinguished from server-measured ones, with the consequence for reporting stated? [Clarity, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the preprocessing latency budget quantified with both a percentile and an input size? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the real-time factor defined, given that avatar feasibility depends on it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK035 Is warm-up handling specified, so cold-start cost is not silently mixed into steady-state figures? [Clarity, Research §R7]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the percentile method specified for small sample counts? [Measurability, Research §R7]
- [ ] CHK037 Is it stated that absolute latency figures are environment-dependent, bounding how they may be compared? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Provider Comparison Consistency

- [ ] CHK038 Are the evaluation criteria enumerated once and applied to every provider, rather than varying per provider? [Consistency, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the minimum number of evaluated providers and of integrated providers stated separately? [Clarity, Spec §FR-043, §FR-045]
- [ ] CHK040 Is each required recommendation category defined, with a traceability obligation to cited evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK041 Is benchmark comparability constrained to identical samples and criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK042 Are provider capabilities required to be queryable data rather than documentation only? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the requirement that a provider be addable without changes elsewhere expressed so it can be objectively checked? [Measurability, Spec §FR-022, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK044 Is behaviour specified for a provider whose credentials are absent, distinguishing "unavailable" from "nonexistent"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK045 Are fallback triggering conditions specified, distinguishing failures worth retrying elsewhere from those that are not? [Gap, Contracts §provider-interface]

## Security Constraint Capture

- [ ] CHK046 Are credential-handling requirements stated for storage, transmission, response payloads, and logs separately? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK047 Is injection prevention required to be structural ("by construction") rather than filter-based? [Clarity, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK048 Are input limits quantified rather than described as "reasonable"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK049 Is the default for logging and retaining user text and audio stated explicitly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK050 Is the no-secret-leakage criterion expressed so it can be automatically verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK051 Are timeout requirements specified for every provider call rather than generally? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK052 Is rate limiting addressed, and is its status as architecture-only versus implemented made explicit? [Gap, Spec §FR-046]

## Production Architecture Requirements

- [ ] CHK053 Are all avatar pipeline stages enumerated as documentation deliverables? [Completeness, Spec §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK054 Is the requirement to explain *where latency accumulates and how to reduce it* stated, not merely to describe the architecture? [Clarity, Spec §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK055 Is the boundary between "documented" and "built" made explicit, so the deliverable is unambiguous? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK056 Are interruption/barge-in and cancellation named as required architecture topics? [Coverage, Spec §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK057 Are operational concerns — observability, scaling, session state, privacy — required alongside the pipeline itself? [Completeness, Spec §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK058 Are setup instructions required to state which capabilities need credentials? [Completeness, Spec §FR-047]

## Cross-Cutting Consistency & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK059 Do the emotion requirements remain consistent given that the target voices expose no native style parameter? [Conflict, Spec §FR-028, Research §R3]
- [ ] CHK060 Is the approximation of style via prosody required to be disclosed rather than presented as native emotion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK061 Is the credential-free-path assumption stated, given that it shapes what can be verified at all? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK062 Is the requirement that the test suite pass without credentials consistent with the requirement to integrate real providers? [Consistency, Spec §SC-015, §FR-045]
- [ ] CHK063 Are the terms "locale", "dialect", "dialect family", and "voice" used consistently across spec, data model, and contracts? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK064 Is automatic diacritization explicitly scoped out rather than left ambiguous? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK065 Are the frontend's exclusion from domain logic and its minimal scope both stated as constraints? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
